question: Will Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva win Brazil's presidential runoff on October 25, 2026?
brief: In the first round on October 4, 2026, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) finished first with 47.03% of valid votes and Lula (PT) second with 45.16%, so the two advance to a runoff on October 25. Pre-election polls had shown Lula slightly ahead, so Flávio outperformed them. Runoff polls conducted October 6-15 mostly show Flávio narrowly ahead: Datafolha (Oct 13-15) Flávio 47%, Lula 45%; Quaest (Oct 10-13) Flávio 46%, Lula 44%; PoderData (Oct 13-15) tied at 47%. Most leads are within the margin of error.

question: Will Western Sydney International Airport begin scheduled passenger flights on or before October 31, 2026?
brief: In June 2026, the Australian government officially announced that Western Sydney International Airport will open to passengers on October 25, 2026, with Jetstar operating the first scheduled passenger service. The airport's freight operations were scheduled to begin on July 26, 2026.
